headline: Keurig Dr Pepper (NASDAQ:KDP) Beats Q2 CY2026 Sales Expectations
summary: Beverage company Keurig Dr Pepper (NASDAQ:KDP) reported Q2 CY2026 results beating Wall Street’s revenue expectations, with sales up 75.6% year on year to $7.31 billion.
